999008199.text: ふう……これであらかた資材は運び終わったな

localizations.en: Phew... That should be most of the materials transported.

999008199.text:
それにしてもすごい規模だな。
まるで町でも作ろうとしているみたいだ

localizations.en: This is quite the operation. It's like they're trying to build an entire town.

999008199.text: ああ。あの町での日々を思い出す

localizations.en: Yeah. It brings back memories of our days in that town.

999008199.text: そうだな。みんな元気にしてるだろうか

localizations.en: It does. I wonder how everyone's doing.

999008199.text: また今度顔を出しにいこう、ロジー

localizations.en: We should drop by for a visit sometime, Logy.

999008199.text:
ああ。そのときは声をかけてくれ。
さあ、最後の一仕事を終わらせるぞ

localizations.en: Absolutely. Let me know when you're planning to go. Now then, let's finish up this last bit of work.

999008199.text:
（レスナのお友達が手伝っているようね。お人好し
　ばかりなのは、レスナの人柄のなせる業かしら）

localizations.en: (It looks like Resna's friends are lending a hand. They're all such good people—I suppose that's a testament to Resna's character.)
